en.title: German Chancellor Merz cancels New York visit

en.title: Iron bar terror: killed uncle, sent aunt to hospital
en.summary: A 20-year-old man in Tarsus, Mersin struck his uncle with an iron bar during a dispute, resulting in the uncle's death and his aunt being hospitalized.

stories.title: Barış Terkoğlu aktardı: Ekrem İmamoğlu'ndan Mansur Yavaş-Erdoğan görüşmesine ilk yorum

en.title: Barış Terkoğlu reports: First commentary from Ekrem İmamoğlu on Mansur Yavaş-Erdoğan meeting
en.summary: Istanbul's mayor Ekrem İmamoğlu commented on opposition leader Mansur Yavaş's meeting with President Erdoğan, stating that while such meetings are acceptable, the timing and scheduling of this particular meeting raises concerns.

stories.title: LGBTİ+ soruşturmasında gazeteci Tuğba Tekerek ve 7 Kaos GL üyesi tutuklandı

en.title: Journalist Tuğba Tekerek and 7 Kaos GL members arrested in LGBT+ investigation
en.summary: Twenty individuals were detained in an Ankara investigation named "Ailem Güvende." Decisions were made regarding 20 of the detainees, with journalist Tuğba Tekerek and 7 LGBT+ organization members among those arrested.

en.title: He killed his uncle with an iron rod and seriously wounded his aunt
en.summary: A man in Tarsus, Mersin fatally attacked his uncle with an iron rod during an argument and seriously injured his aunt. Police detained the suspect and continue investigating the homicide.

en.title: LGBT+ operations: Journalist Tuğba Tekerek and Kaos GL members arrested
en.summary: Seven board members of LGBT+ organization Kaos GL were arrested in an Ankara investigation titled "Ailem Güvende." Seven alternate members were released under judicial supervision measures.
